snippet.title: Trivia Deal - Roguelike Reveal
snippet.description:
Trivia Deal is the first ever trivia roguelike game, blending the brain-teasing fun of trivia with the addictive strategy and endless replayability of roguelikes.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820760/Trivia_Deal/
